# beenfar Provider

Manages a [beenfar](https://github.com/jacobalberty/beenfar) network controller: networks, wifi networks, RADIUS servers, switch ports and device adoption.

Resources only manage the attributes set in their configuration. Attributes left out are neither changed nor reported as drift, so the same resource can be managed partly by Terraform and partly by the beenfar UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    beenfar = {
      source = "jacobalberty/beenfar"
    }
  }
}

# The URL and token can also come from BEENFAR_URL and BEENFAR_TOKEN.
# Create a token with: beenfard admin token -username admin -name terraform
provider "beenfar" {
  url   = "https://beenfar.example:8080"
  token = var.beenfar_token
}

variable "beenfar_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) API token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. Create one with `beenfard admin token`. Defaults to the `BEENFAR_TOKEN` environment variable. The `beenfar_adapters` data source needs an admin's token.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the controller, e.g. `https://beenfar.example:8080`. Defaults to the `BEENFAR_URL` environment variable.
